Starting today, Runna subscription users can use the newly launched "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna launches training tool to help runners cope with hot weather

Personal running coach app Runna announced three updates today, aimed at providing comprehensive support to users throughout their entire training cycle—from training in hot weather to post-race recovery, covering every aspect.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature officially launches today, helping users find cooler running periods and recommending adjustments to pace targets based on perceived temperature, training duration, and specific workouts.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature is equipped with color-coded hourly weather forecasts, allowing users to identify the most suitable times for running at a glance, thereby planning their training properly.

Runna shared the following about this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature—whenever a user starts a training plan for a 5km to 50km event, the system will automatically create a recovery plan for them. Runna head coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell stated that these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury."

Finally, the platform announced that the new feature "Upcoming Plans" will launch in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans and seamlessly transition to the next plan after completion, further simplifying long-term training management.

Runna outlined the benefits of "Upcoming Plans" as follows:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: Runners can stack multiple races, transition goals, and training phases, giving you a clear overview of the year at a glance. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch—preferred training schedules, predicted finish times, and current fitness levels automatically carry over from the end of one plan to the start of the next. Flexibility and autonomy: Each plan can be edited, replaced, or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control over their training experience. Designed for progress: Each plan is designed by Runna's experienced coaches based on proven training principles, helping runners continue to improve, recover fully, and be in the best shape possible on race day.
